test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

A. Booming with private developers

B. And it is changing the landscape of the urban and semi-urban habitat

C. Making the Indian elevator industry the second highest market in the world

D. India’s real estate business is
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **DABC**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "India's real estate business is," which is correctly indicated by **part (D).**
 
• Following the subject, "booming with private developers" **(DA)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what the real estate business is doing.
 
• **The next part,** "and it is changing the landscape of the urban and semi-urban habitat," **(DAB)** starts the explanation about the impact of the booming business.
 
• **Ending with** "making the Indian elevator industry the second highest market in the world" **(DABC)** completes the sentence by stating the result of the booming real estate business.

Therefore, the correct answer is **DABC.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (DBAC):** This option starts with "India's real estate business is and it is changing the landscape of the urban and semi-urban habitat," which makes the sentence incomplete and confusing.
 
• **Option 3 (ABCD):** This option starts with "booming with private developers and it is changing the landscape of the urban and semi-urban habitat," which misses the subject and creates an unclear sentence.
 
• **Option 4 (BACD):** This option starts with "and it is changing the landscape of the urban and semi-urban habitat making the Indian elevator industry the second highest market in the world," which lacks the proper introduction of the subject.
